title: Aircall vs Calilio for HubSpot Teams — Jon Martin
seoTitle: Aircall vs Calilio for Small HubSpot Teams
description: Aircall or Calilio for a small team on HubSpot: entry prices, seat minimums, what lands in HubSpot, and which plan has a power dialer.
h1: Aircall vs Calilio for a small team on HubSpot
dek: Both are cloud phone systems that log calls into HubSpot. The price floor is very different.
Prices and integration details come from each vendor's own pages, checked on the date shown.

blocks.html: This is for a small team that runs {{link:hubspot}} and needs business phone numbers with calls logged to the CRM. Maybe it's two reps and a founder, maybe it's a five-person inbound desk.
The rule I use for any phone system on HubSpot: pick it by where the call record ends up. If calls don't land on the HubSpot record, your activity reports are missing half the work.

Aircall is the safer pick if you want call activity on deals and tickets, not only contacts, and you have at least three people on the phones. Calilio is the cheaper pick for a very small team. Its HubSpot connection is newer; {{fact:calilio.hubspot_launch}}.
Both give you a way out if it doesn't fit. Calilio offers {{fact:calilio.money_back}}. Aircall's pricing page offers free access to try it.

Aircall Essentials is {{fact:aircall.essentials_annual}}. Professional is {{fact:aircall.professional_license}}. There's {{fact:aircall.min_licenses_ess_pro}}, so the smallest Essentials account runs about {{calc:aircall_min_3}} a month. Aircall's page shows {{fact:aircall.annual_saving}}. {{fact:aircall.power_dialer}}.

Calilio Standard is {{fact:calilio.standard_price}}. Premium is {{fact:calilio.premium_price}}. Three Standard users on annual billing run about {{calc:calilio_3}} a month. Plan limits: {{fact:calilio.standard_users}}. {{fact:calilio.power_dialer}}.
With Calilio, {{fact:calilio.hubspot_logging}}. The integration page lists {{fact:calilio.hubspot_events}}, and the pricing table shows {{fact:calilio.hubspot_both_plans}}.

The difference that matters for most HubSpot teams: Aircall names deals and tickets as places call activity lands. Calilio's HubSpot page describes the contact timeline and doesn't mention deals or tickets. If your reports are built on deals, ask Calilio about that before you switch.
One to three callers, mostly contact-level follow-up, tight budget: Calilio. Three or more callers, call activity reported on deals or tickets, or a service team creating tickets from calls: Aircall.
Need a power dialer? On Aircall that means Professional; on Calilio it means Premium. Price the plan that has it, not the entry plan.

faq.q: Which is cheaper, Aircall or Calilio?
faq.a: Calilio. Standard is {{fact:calilio.standard_price}}. Aircall Essentials is {{fact:aircall.essentials_annual}}, with {{fact:aircall.min_licenses_ess_pro}}.

closing: Pick the phone system by where the call record ends up: Aircall for deals and tickets, Calilio for a lean team logging to contacts.

Minimum seats.calilio: No minimum listed; Standard caps at 10 users.

Calls logged in HubSpot.calilio: Contact timeline, on both plans; its HubSpot page doesn't mention deals.
